big_case.notes: Emergency-docket stay of a sector-wide injunction halting border-barrier construction across the Big Bend Sector, resolved by a signed-off per curiam (one noted dissent) holding there is no such thing as a constitutional major-questions claim for purposes of IIRIRA 102(c)(2)(A)'s review bar. Real national policy and environmental stakes and a doctrinal statement with reach beyond the case, but an interim order on a narrow jurisdictional question rather than a merits landmark.

central_claims.basis: Nov 9 order stays the injunction pending the filing and disposition of the Government's cert petition.
central_claims.claim: The Court will grant an unqualified stay of the W.D. Tex. injunction pending timely filing and disposition of a cert petition, letting construction resume.

central_claims.basis: Per curiam: 'However it is labeled, respondents' claim ... alleges instead that the Secretary exceeded his statutory authority'; 'no such thing as a constitutional major-questions claim'.
central_claims.claim: The basis: the injunction rests on a statutory-authority objection that cannot be converted into a constitutional claim by invoking the major-questions doctrine, so the government is very likely to succeed under the review bar.

central_claims.basis: Response requested Oct 22; referred to the Court Nov 9; disposed by the full Court Nov 9.
central_claims.claim: Response request, referral and full-Court disposition approximately Oct 28 through Nov 11, rather than in-chambers resolution.

central_claims.basis: Per curiam: injunction impedes compelling border-security interests and unrecoupable costs; government's interest outweighs aesthetic, recreational and environmental harm.
central_claims.claim: The Court will weight the government's construction-disruption and border-security injuries over respondents' environmental and historic-resource harms.

central_claims.basis: The Court granted the stay and did not treat the application as a petition or summarily reverse; it did explain the stay in a short per curiam.
central_claims.claim: A concise stay order is more likely than summary reversal on the merits.
